LCNC-SEC-03: Data Leakage and Unexpected Consequences Low-code/no-code applications can sync data or trigger operations across multiple systems, which creates a path for data to find its way outside the organizational boundary. This means that operations in one system can have unexpected consequences in another. — slide 15 of 24
